import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

for target, source in re.findall(r'\b(TMP|a|b)\s*<-\s*(TMP|a|b|\d+)\b', text):
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
